CANVAS WIDTH 48 HEIGHT 64
BUDGET INSTRUCTIONS 2000 GENERATED_SHAPES 100 RASTER_CELLS 8192 RECURSION_DEPTH 16

CONST $cx I32 24
CONST $ground_y I32 56
CONST $trunk_top_y I32 28
CONST $canopy_center_y I32 22

CONST $bark_mid COLOR #57534E
CONST $bark_base COLOR #292524
CONST $bark_dark COLOR #1C1917
CONST $shadow_abyss COLOR #04060E

# --- Semantic Layer 1: ground_shadow ---
SHAPE $ground_shadow_ellipse (CIRCLE CENTER (VEC2 (PX $cx) (PX $ground_y)) RADIUS (PX 12))
LAYER ground_shadow ORDER 5 {
  PAINT $ground_shadow_ellipse FILL $shadow_abyss RASTER MIDPOINT
}

# --- Semantic Layer 2: roots_and_ground ---
SHAPE $root_left (LINE FROM (VEC2 (PX (SUB $cx 8)) (PX (ADD $ground_y 2))) TO (VEC2 (PX $cx) (PX (SUB $ground_y 3))))
SHAPE $root_right (LINE FROM (VEC2 (PX (ADD $cx 8)) (PX (ADD $ground_y 2))) TO (VEC2 (PX $cx) (PX (SUB $ground_y 3))))
LAYER roots_and_ground ORDER 10 {
  PAINT $root_left FILL $bark_dark RASTER MIDPOINT
  PAINT $root_right FILL $bark_dark RASTER MIDPOINT
}

# --- Semantic Layer 3: trunk ---
SHAPE $trunk_rect (RECT CENTER (VEC2 (PX $cx) (PX (DIV (ADD $trunk_top_y $ground_y) 2))) SIZE (VEC2 (PX 8) (PX (SUB $ground_y $trunk_top_y))))
LAYER trunk ORDER 20 {
  PAINT $trunk_rect FILL $bark_mid RASTER MIDPOINT
}

# --- Semantic Layer 4: primary_branches ---
SHAPE $branch_left (LINE FROM (VEC2 (PX $cx) (PX (ADD $trunk_top_y 4))) TO (VEC2 (PX (SUB $cx 12)) (PX (SUB $trunk_top_y 6))))

LAYER primary_branches ORDER 30 {
  PAINT $branch_left FILL $bark_base RASTER MIDPOINT
  PAINT $branch_right FILL $bark_base RASTER MIDPOINT
}

# --- Semantic Layer 5: secondary_branches ---
SHAPE $twig_left (LINE FROM (VEC2 (PX (SUB $cx 12)) (PX (SUB $trunk_top_y 6))) TO (VEC2 (PX (SUB $cx 16)) (PX (SUB $trunk_top_y 14))))
SHAPE $twig_right (LINE FROM (VEC2 (PX (ADD $cx 12)) (PX (SUB $trunk_top_y 6))) TO (VEC2 (PX (ADD $cx 16)) (PX (SUB $trunk_top_y 14))))
LAYER secondary_branches ORDER 40 {
  PAINT $twig_left FILL $bark_lit RASTER MIDPOINT
  PAINT $twig_right FILL $bark_lit RASTER MIDPOINT
}

# --- Semantic Layer 6: canopy_masses ---
SHAPE $canopy_main (CIRCLE CENTER (VEC2 (PX $cx) (PX $canopy_center_y)) RADIUS (PX 16))
SHAPE $canopy_left (CIRCLE CENTER (VEC2 (PX (SUB $cx 8)) (PX (ADD $canopy_center_y 4))) RADIUS (PX 8))
SHAPE $canopy_right (CIRCLE CENTER (VEC2 (PX (ADD $cx 8)) (PX (ADD $canopy_center_y 4))) RADIUS (PX 8))

  PAINT $canopy_main FILL $canopy_base RASTER MIDPOINT
  PAINT $canopy_left FILL $canopy_mid RASTER MIDPOINT
  PAINT $canopy_right FILL $canopy_mid RASTER MIDPOINT
}

# --- Semantic Layer 7: foliage_edges ---

LAYER foliage_edges ORDER 60 {
  PAINT $fringe_top FILL $canopy_lit RASTER MIDPOINT
}

# --- Semantic Layer 8: surface_detail ---

CONST $bark_base COLOR #3A2410
CONST $bark_dark COLOR #241408
CONST $shadow_abyss COLOR #04060E

# --- Semantic Layer 1: ground_shadow ---
SHAPE $ground_shadow_ellipse (CIRCLE CENTER (VEC2 (PX $cx) (PX $ground_y)) RADIUS (PX 12))
LAYER ground_shadow ORDER 5 {
  PAINT $ground_shadow_ellipse FILL $shadow_abyss RASTER MIDPOINT
}

# --- Semantic Layer 2: roots_and_ground ---
SHAPE $root_left (LINE FROM (VEC2 (PX (SUB $cx 8)) (PX (ADD $ground_y 2))) TO (VEC2 (PX $cx) (PX (SUB $ground_y 3))))
SHAPE $root_right (LINE FROM (VEC2 (PX (ADD $cx 8)) (PX (ADD $ground_y 2))) TO (VEC2 (PX $cx) (PX (SUB $ground_y 3))))
LAYER roots_and_ground ORDER 10 {
  PAINT $root_left FILL $bark_dark RASTER MIDPOINT
  PAINT $root_right FILL $bark_dark RASTER MIDPOINT
}

# --- Semantic Layer 3: trunk ---
SHAPE $trunk_rect (RECT CENTER (VEC2 (PX $cx) (PX (DIV (ADD $trunk_top_y $ground_y) 2))) SIZE (VEC2 (PX 8) (PX (SUB $ground_y $trunk_top_y))))
LAYER trunk ORDER 20 {
  PAINT $trunk_rect FILL $bark_mid RASTER MIDPOINT
}

# --- Semantic Layer 4: primary_branches ---
SHAPE $branch_left (LINE FROM (VEC2 (PX $cx) (PX (ADD $trunk_top_y 4))) TO (VEC2 (PX (SUB $cx 12)) (PX (SUB $trunk_top_y 6))))
SHAPE $branch_right (LINE FROM (VEC2 (PX $cx) (PX (ADD $trunk_top_y 4))) TO (VEC2 (PX (ADD $cx 12)) (PX (SUB $trunk_top_y 6))))
LAYER primary_branches ORDER 30 {
  PAINT $branch_left FILL $bark_base RASTER MIDPOINT
  PAINT $branch_right FILL $bark_base RASTER MIDPOINT
}

# --- Semantic Layer 5: secondary_branches ---
SHAPE $twig_left (LINE FROM (VEC2 (PX (SUB $cx 12)) (PX (SUB $trunk_top_y 6))) TO (VEC2 (PX (SUB $cx 16)) (PX (SUB $trunk_top_y 14))))
SHAPE $twig_right (LINE FROM (VEC2 (PX (ADD $cx 12)) (PX (SUB $trunk_top_y 6))) TO (VEC2 (PX (ADD $cx 16)) (PX (SUB $trunk_top_y 14))))
LAYER secondary_branches ORDER 40 {
  PAINT $twig_left FILL $bark_lit RASTER MIDPOINT
  PAINT $twig_right FILL $bark_lit RASTER MIDPOINT
}

# --- Semantic Layer 6: canopy_masses ---
SHAPE $canopy_main (CIRCLE CENTER (VEC2 (PX $cx) (PX $canopy_center_y)) RADIUS (PX 11))
SHAPE $canopy_left (CIRCLE CENTER (VEC2 (PX (SUB $cx 8)) (PX (ADD $canopy_center_y 4))) RADIUS (PX 5))
SHAPE $canopy_right (CIRCLE CENTER (VEC2 (PX (ADD $cx 8)) (PX (ADD $canopy_center_y 4))) RADIUS (PX 5))
LAYER canopy_masses ORDER 50 {
  PAINT $canopy_main FILL $canopy_base RASTER MIDPOINT
  PAINT $canopy_left FILL $canopy_mid RASTER MIDPOINT
  PAINT $canopy_right FILL $canopy_mid RASTER MIDPOINT
}

# --- Semantic Layer 7: foliage_edges ---
SHAPE $fringe_top (CIRCLE CENTER (VEC2 (PX $cx) (PX (SUB $canopy_center_y 8))) RADIUS (PX 4))
LAYER foliage_edges ORDER 60 {
  PAINT $fringe_top FILL $canopy_lit RASTER MIDPOINT
}

# --- Semantic Layer 8: surface_detail ---
SHAPE $trunk_grain (LINE FROM (VEC2 (PX $cx) (PX (ADD $trunk_top_y 6))) TO (VEC2 (PX $cx) (PX (SUB $ground_y 4))))
LAYER surface_detail ORDER 70 {
  PAINT $trunk_grain FILL $bark_lit RASTER MIDPOINT
}

# --- Semantic Layer 9: highlights ---
SHAPE $canopy_glint (PIXEL AT (VEC2 (PX (SUB $cx 6)) (PX (SUB $canopy_center_y 10))))
LAYER highlights ORDER 80 {
  PAINT $canopy_glint FILL $canopy_spec RASTER CENTER
}
